text: City staff will provide an update as the status of hiring an Investment Consultant for the Toronto Investment Board ("the Board"). The Investment Consultant (Aon Hewitt) will be introduced and provide a presentation to the Board.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Requested the consultant, Aon Hewitt, to work with Corporate Finance staff and report on: a. a recommended asset mix and the basis for such recommendation; b. a recommended Investment Manager Structure; and c. common terminology to be used by the Board.
